name: Montcalm County, MI
findings: Montcalm County has 175 nonprofit organizations. 77 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Montcalm County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 15 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
